item.title: Quantifying electronic insulation of solid-electrolyte interphases through electrolyte decomposition kinetics
item.description:
این مقاله با بررسی سینتیک تجزیه الکترولیت، عایق‌بودن الکترونیکی لایه بین‌فازی الکترولیت جامد (SEI) را کمّی می‌کند که برای عملکرد باتری‌های لیتیوم-یون حیاتی است.
npj Computational Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces RED, a computational framework combining Marcus theory and constrained DFT to quantify SEI electronic insulation via electrolyte decomposition kinetics. Unlike prior methods focused solely on electronic coupling, RED integrates reorganization energy, revealing that it can reverse insulation rankings. This enables component-resolved, electrolyte-dependent evaluation, identifying Li2CO3's high insulation and establishing a proof-of-concept for studying heterogeneous SEIs.
🏷 solid-electrolyte interphase · electrolyte decomposition · electronic insulation · kinetics · lithium-ion battery

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Ferroelectric BaTiO₃-coated track-etched membranes with vertically aligned, low-tortuosity channels are introduced as separators for solid-state lithium metal batteries. Combined with in situ polymerized PDOL, they shorten Li⁺ pathways and homogenize electric fields, enabling dendrite-free plating, high conductivity (0.12 mS cm⁻¹), and stable cycling. This geometrically engineered ferroelectric separator paradigm advances safe, high-performance lithium metal batteries.
